_comment_3: PURPOSE: A deliberately misconfigured storage resource.
_comment_4: RESULT: FAILS multiple OPA policy checks.
_comment_5: USE CASE: Demonstrates what a real-world misconfiguration looks
_comment_6: like and how the pipeline catches it BEFORE deployment.
_comment_7: INTENTIONAL VIOLATIONS: See inline comments for details.

encryption._violation: VIOLATION 1 — SC-28: Encryption is explicitly disabled. Stored data is in plaintext.

public_access._violation: VIOLATION 2 — AC-3, SC-7: All four public access controls are turned off.
public_access._violation_2: This bucket is fully accessible from the public internet.

logging._violation: VIOLATION 3 — AU-2: Logging is disabled. No audit trail exists for this bucket.
logging._violation_2: There is no record of who accessed or modified any object.

versioning._violation: VIOLATION 4 — CP-9: Versioning is disabled on what appears to be a production resource.
versioning._violation_2: Deleted or overwritten objects are not recoverable.

cors._violation: ADDITIONAL RISK: CORS is enabled with a wildcard origin (not checked by current policy)

tags._violation: VIOLATION 5 — CM-8: environment tag has an invalid value ('unknown' is not allowed).
tags._violation_2: VIOLATION 6 — CM-8(1): owner tag is missing entirely.
tags._violation_3: VIOLATION 7 — PM-5: data_classification is missing entirely.
